mechanism: Valproic acid may inhibit methylphenidate metabolism via CYP450 enzymes, potentially increasing methylphenidate levels; combined CNS stimulation and valproic acid's effect on dopamine/norepinephrine systems may increase seizure risk in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor for increased methylphenidate adverse effects (tremor, insomnia, tachycardia) and seizure activity; consider dose adjustment or alternative stimulant if clinically indicated; ensure adequate seizure control maintained.
